g.text: Packet-length distribution: a control-heavy mode plus an inflated tail

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: n = 68,695,723 packets. The 64-127 B mode is ACK/control traffic; the >1518 B tail exceeds Ethernet MTU and points to capture-side offload. Source:

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: cap_20260920_111416/112321/112821/113321.pcap (4 files, 17.2 min; two continuous blocks of 192 s and 842 s). One-way byte convention; loopback and

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Times New Roman', serif; fill: #6b6b6b

g.text: non-IP traffic are handled per the data-convention note. Time-based statements are limited to those two blocks.
